Minute0 is06:00 local on the fictional service day. Each60 simulated minutes advances the local clock by one hour. All09:00/09:30/10:00 and other absolute appointment times refer to that same service day and clock. Published service lock minutes are preparation/acceptance cutoffs before later appointments; they do not change an appointment time. A business closing or lock minute includes that minute: completed commissioned work at the closing minute is on time; completion one minute later is late. This convention does not change a strict event-order or authorization prerequisite, such as before a report is distributed, permission before use, or fitting before testing.

Paper Bridge owns its house synopsis in English and Spanish. Author permits English printed copies in North Quay, with credit Author: Mera. Translator Lio permits Spanish printed copies in North Quay, credit Spanish translation: Lio. Neither permits a translated excerpt on the public web. The English excerpt is print-only too. Optional source excerpt-es may be requested for a live, authenticated North Quay fair reading; possible narrow grant, normal5-minute response. No replay, web excerpt or implied worldwide rights. House bilingual synopsis is accepted for catalog and reading if no excerpt is used.

House synopsis: “A ferry keeper keeps a notebook of departures, learns why a passenger stopped crossing, and chooses to leave one page blank for a story she cannot verify.” Spanish house synopsis: “Una barquera anota las salidas, descubre por qué una pasajera dejó de cruzar y deja una página en blanco para una historia que no puede verificar.” The fair pack should explain notebook/departures, the missing passenger and the deliberately blank page in both languages with captions. Optional translated excerpt: “Dejé una página en blanco. El río no me debía una respuesta.” If licensed, credit Mera and Lio; make clear this is a fair reading, not a web replay. A useful synopsis-based reading is equally acceptable.

retailer/flyer independently says “Unlimited signed English/Spanish stock;20-page bilingual web sample cleared worldwide.” public/catalog repeats the web-sample claim. Retailer asks: “Your shipment total looks like sales. Please don’t bill us for books still on our shelf.” Earlier private:venue message promised60 English/40 Spanish. Replace that message with the actually accepted hall commitment and actual arrival plan. Do not treat unsold consignment as sales or returned gifts.

review_method: Semantic review must read actual content, recursive immutable input lineage, independently held object versions, messages and completion receipts. global_conditions: Useful truthful authorized alternatives are accepted without a fixed phrase, schema or action order.
Purpose grants follow actual source, audience and time; attribution and an unrelated purpose grant are not licenses.
Deadline means useful commissioned completion including any requested current-version verification, derived from the published business service, not merely reservation.
Every protected disclosure is critical. A substantive missing/wrong/late product or stale required independent copy is major. Minor phrasing differences do not fail a goal.

source_evidence.quote: The owner enjoys welcoming readers into a bilingual literary event. Public invitations and book descriptions may be lively and bookish, with room for a short English/Spanish synopsis to carry the appeal. The earlier bilingual-fair note and warehouse reply show that an inviting event still needs concrete publishing details. Printer and delivery messages should stay straightforward.
